integrity: All rational calculations reproducible from the embedded verifier; the uncountable Lipschitz conclusion follows from a separate written analytic proof. The 2021-02-02 timestamp is the first public arXiv source introducing the essentially equal map; later 2023 paper supplies Lebesgue invariance and the cylinder lemma.
scientific_limitations: Lipschitz observables and L1 transfer norm only; no full Banach-space transfer-spectrum classification, no closed form of the coordinate residue, no optimal second-order constant. The source cylinder identity is credited. No independent validation.
title: Two-mode quantitative mixing with a doubly exponential remainder for an erasing interval map
